ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: I'll just tell them in order, then. First, the airship...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Тогда расскажу по порядку. Сначала — дирижабль...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: And so, barely defeating Ilmeria, I had to fight Miss Sophie for the final exam!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: И вот, едва победив Ильмерию, мне пришлось сразиться с мисс Софи на выпускном экзамене!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: On the next episode of Firis, Burning Alchemist! "The Final Battle, Teacher and Student!"
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: В следующем выпуске «Фирис, пылающий алхимик»! «Последняя битва: учитель и ученица!»

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Uwah! Not sure where the episodic format came from, but you've lived quite a wild life!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Ува! Не знаю, откуда взялся сериальный формат, но жизнь у тебя была бурная!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Tell me about it. I've read novels with less twists and turns, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Ещё бы. Я читала романы с меньшим числом поворотов, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: These are my treasured memories, after all. I'll never forget any of them, as long as I live.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: В конце концов, это мои драгоценные воспоминания. Не забуду ни одного, пока жива.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Treasures! I love the sound of that! We need to travel and get some treasures of our own!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Сокровища! Обожаю, как это звучит! Нам тоже нужно путешествовать и добыть свои!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Right! Loads of them!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Точно! Целую кучу!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Hehe. That's it for today, anyway. I've kept you too long already. Come again any time, though.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Хе-хе. На сегодня всё. Я вас и так слишком долго держала. Но приходите снова в любое время.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Great, I can't wait. Let's get going, Lydie!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Отлично, не могу дождаться. Пойдём, Лиди!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Wait for me, Sue! We need to get home and start making our own travel plans!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Подожди меня, Сью! Нужно домой и строить собственные планы путешествий!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Lydie, Sue. I can't wait to hear the stories of your own adventures.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Лиди, Сью. Не терпится услышать истории о ваших собственных приключениях.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: A new Combination Art for Sue and Firis <CLEG>"Firis and Sue Surprise"<CLNR> is unlocked.<CR>
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Разблокировано новое Комбинированное искусство для Сью и Фирис <CLEG>«Сюрприз Фирис и Сью»<CLNR>.<CR>

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Firis, was that a sigh? Is something wrong? Are you hungry?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Фирис, это был вздох? Что-то не так? Ты голодна?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Or some meat you were looking forward to eating has been eaten by someone else?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Или мясо, которого ждала, кто-то уже съел?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: All I think about is food, is that it? Thanks.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Значит, я только и думаю о еде? Спасибо.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: I wasn't thinking about my next meal, actually, but about Ilmeria.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: На самом деле я думала не о следующем обеде, а об Ильмерии.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Ilmeria? You mean, about the atelier you used to run together?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Ильмерия? Про ателье, которым вы вместе управляли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Yeah. She's the one who invited me to join her.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Ага. Это она пригласила меня к себе.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: But then I headed off alone on my travels, betraying her.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: А потом я ушла одна в путешествие, предав её.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: She told me it was okay, but I still feel guilty...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Она сказала, что всё в порядке, но я всё равно чувствую вину...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: She's not bothered by it at all. She told us! Told us she was happy you went traveling.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Её это совсем не беспокоит. Она нам сказала! Сказала, что рада, что ты отправилась в путь.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Come on, you know Ilmeria. She isn't always honest about her feelings, even with herself.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Да ладно, ты же знаешь Ильмерию. Она не всегда честна в чувствах — даже с собой.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Someone else isn't being honest about feelings here! You should ask her, if it bothers you that much!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Кто-то здесь тоже нечестен в чувствах! Спроси её, если тебя это так мучает!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Sitting around worrying isn't like you, Firis. Bring back some of that Firis energy!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Сидеть и тревожиться — это не ты, Фирис. Верни себе энергию Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Girls. You're right, of course. All right!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: I'm going to go and ask Il, straight up, what she thinks of me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Пойду и прямо спрошу Ил, что она обо мне думает.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Good, that's the way. I'm sure it will turn out fine.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Вот так. Уверена, всё будет хорошо.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Thank you! Right, I just need to maintain my resolve!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Спасибо! Да, нужно просто сохранить решимость!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Stay calm, stay calm. I need to do this. I'm just going to find out the truth, that's all.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Спокойно, спокойно. Нужно это сделать. Просто узнать правду, вот и всё.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Hey, it's Firis. She looks a bit nervous...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: О, это Фирис. Выглядит немного нервной...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Very well. Time for us to step in.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Хорошо. Пора нам вмешаться.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Hey, Firis! What a surprise, running into you here!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Эй, Фирис! Какая встреча — вот так наткнуться на тебя!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: We were just going to see our teacher. Why don't you come along with us?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Мы как раз шли к нашей учительнице. Почему бы тебе не пойти с нами?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Uwah, hold on! Hey, don't drag me!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ува, погодите! Эй, не тащите меня!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ah, hello you three. You've become quite close, haven't you all?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ах, привет вам троим. Вы стали довольно близки, да?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: It's nothing like that. In this case, anyway. Firis was waiting outside the atelier.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ничего подобного. Во всяком случае, сейчас. Фирис ждала возле ателье.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ehehe. Firis. There's something you want to ask Ilmeria, isn't there?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Эхе-хе. Фирис. Ты ведь хочешь кое-что спросить у Ильмерии?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ugwah, you're ganging up on me! Fine, fine!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Угва, вы на меня насели! Ладно, ладно!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ilmeria! Be honest. Aren't you angry that I left the atelier and went off on my own?!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ильмерия! Будь честна. Ты не злишься, что я ушла из ателье и ушла одна?!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Not really?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Не особо?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: That was quick! You don't think I was selfish? Leaving you like that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Быстро же! Не думаешь, что я была эгоисткой? Бросила тебя вот так?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: No, I don't. Like I've already told those two, I'm not bothered at all.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Нет. Как я уже говорила этим двоим — меня это совсем не беспокоит.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: You are freedom personified. Like a tuna, unable to stay in one place.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ты — олицетворение свободы. Как тунец, который не может оставаться на месте.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: A t-tuna? I admit I can't settle down, but still, I'm not a fish!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Т-тунец? Признаю, не могу усидеть, но всё же я не рыба!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Also, I think you need to do something with your habit to overthink something all on your own.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: И ещё: тебе стоит что-то сделать с привычкой всё обдумывать в одиночку.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: You get so serious about the strangest things. Can't you just be carefree all the time?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ты так серьёзно относишься к самым странным вещам. Нельзя ли просто всегда быть беззаботной?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: You think so? Hahaha, I guess I did it again! Hehehe!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Думаешь? Ха-ха-ха, кажется, я снова это сделала! Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: That Puni-like smile, that's it. That's the Firis I want to see.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Вот эта улыбка как у Пуни — да. Такую Фирис я и хочу видеть.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: But wherever you go, and whatever you see, in the end make sure you come back to me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Но куда бы ты ни пошла и что бы ни увидела — в итоге обязательно возвращайся ко мне.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: I haven't given up on running an atelier with you, yet, either.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Я ещё не отказалась от идеи вести ателье вместе с тобой.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Okay. I can make that promise. I'll come back and see you, when I'm ready.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Хорошо. Могу это пообещать. Вернусь и увидимся, когда буду готова.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Just wait until then, Il!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Просто подожди до тех пор, Ил!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: I think that takes care of that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Кажется, на этом всё?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: I think so. Hehe, I'm glad.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Думаю, да. Хе-хе, я рада.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Firis has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Wealth of Experience"<CLNR>.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Фирис получила навык <CLEG>«Богатство опыта»<CLNR>.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Hmm, what else do I need? I need some more rations, and a blanket too.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Хм, что ещё нужно? Ещё пайки и одеяло.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Rations? Are you planning some kind of trip?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Ah, yeah. I've seen Sophie and the others here. I'm going to leave Merveille, for a while.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Ах, да. Я видела здесь Софи и остальных. На время покину Мервейль.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Of course... You're a tuna, after all, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Конечно... Ты же всё-таки тунец, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Stop calling me a fish! Uwah, now I feel all smelly!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Хватит называть меня рыбой! Ува, теперь я чувствую себя вонючей!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Wow, so you're leaving, Firis... Any idea where you are going?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Ух ты, значит, ты уходишь, Фирис... Есть идея, куда?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: No, I haven't decided. I'm just going to see where my feet take me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Нет, ещё не решила. Просто пойду, куда поведут ноги.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: But I've decided on a plan. I'm going to repay my debts to everyone!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Но план есть. Я верну долги всем!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Just like before, I'm going to study all sorts of things as I travel.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Как и раньше, буду изучать всё подряд в пути.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Then I'm going to use the things I've learned to help all the people who've helped me!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: А потом использую то, чему научилась, чтобы помочь всем, кто помогал мне!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: That's how I'm going to repay them all. A bit vague, perhaps, but that suits my style!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Вот так я всем отплачу. Может, немного расплывчато — но это в моём стиле!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Yes, it's just like you, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Да, это совсем как ты, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: A kind and fine goal to have. We'll be behind you all the way, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Добрая и прекрасная цель. Мы будем за тебя до конца, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Hehe, thanks. That really gets me fired up to do this!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Хе-хе, спасибо. Это и правда зажигает меня!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Right! You just wait for me, world! I'm going to repay everyone who's been kind to me! Hahaha!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Точно! Жди меня, мир! Я отплачу всем, кто был добр ко мне! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Hey, girls. There's something I want to talk to you about.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Эй, девочки. Хочу с вами кое о чём поговорить.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: I want to give something as a gift to everyone who has helped me around here.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Хочу подарить что-нибудь каждому, кто мне здесь помогал.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: I've got something for most people, but I've gone a bit overboard on my gift for Ilmeria.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Для большинства уже есть, но с подарком для Ильмерии я немного переборщила.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Let me guess. You've run out of materials?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Yes, that's right. I'm sorry, but could you help me with the synthesis?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Да, именно. Извините, но не могли бы вы помочь с синтезом?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: No trouble at all! Hehe! A good chance to show you our progress, too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Никаких проблем! Хе-хе! И хороший шанс показать тебе наш прогресс!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Ah, bold words! I've got this note here with everything I need.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Ах, смелые слова! У меня здесь записка со всем, что нужно.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Lydie, Sue. I'll be counting on you!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Here you go, Firis. We've made the items you wanted.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Вот, Фирис. Мы сделали то, что ты хотела.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Thanks! Yes, these look very well made.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Спасибо! Да, выглядит очень хорошо сделанным.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Right, now it's my turn! I'll synth this up in a moment, just hold on.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Отлично, теперь моя очередь! Сейчас синтезирую, подождите немного.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Great! We'll watch and get some tips!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Отлично! Посмотрим и наберёмся советов!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: It's done! This is what I'm going to give to Ilmeria!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Готово! Вот что я подарю Ильмерии!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hold on, Firis. What is this?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Погоди, Фирис. Что это?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: I'll explain later. I have to get this to her at once!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Объясню позже. Нужно срочно отнести ей!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Here you are again. What is it this time?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Снова ты. Что на этот раз?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hehehe! I've got a present for you today!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Сегодня у меня для тебя подарок!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Here you are. A thank you for everything you do for me!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Вот. Спасибо за всё, что ты для меня делаешь!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: What is this? Some kind of item for bending space?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Что это? Какой-то предмет для искривления пространства?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: That's right, Il! It's a tool that lets you move freely between two points.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Точно, Ил! Инструмент, который позволяет свободно перемещаться между двумя точками.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Two points? Which means...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Двумя точками? Значит...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: I can move freely between your atelier and mine?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Я могу свободно ходить между твоим ателье и моим?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: That's right. We can meet up whenever we like!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Именно. Сможем встречаться, когда захотим!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: This is proof of my promise to come back to you. Will you accept it?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Это доказательство моего обещания вернуться к тебе. Примешь?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Wow. You made this crazy item just to keep your promise? You dummy! You super dummy!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Ух ты. Ты сделала эту безумную вещь только чтобы сдержать обещание? Дурочка! Супердурочка!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hey, don't call me dummy! It wasn't easy to think this up, you know!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Эй, не называй меня дурочкой! Знаешь, нелегко было это придумать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: I know. Thank you, Firis. The strength of your feelings have reached me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Знаю. Спасибо, Фирис. Сила твоих чувств до меня дошла.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Remember this, though. With this item I can now visit your atelier at any time.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Но запомни. С этим предметом я теперь могу явиться в твоё ателье в любое время.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: If you take too long coming back, I'll be over to bother you every day!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Если будешь слишком долго возвращаться — буду приходить и доставать тебя каждый день!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hahaha, I'll keep that in mind! We'll be friends forever, Il!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Ха-ха-ха, буду иметь в виду! Мы друзья навсегда, Ил!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: We certainly will, if I have anything to say about it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Обязательно будем, если от меня что-то зависит.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Sue. Sue! Let's leave them too it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Сью. Сью! Оставим их наедине.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Yeah, we should. I hope you two are very happy together!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Да, стоит. Надеюсь, вы двое будете очень счастливы вместе!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Lydie! Sue! I'm coming in!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Лиди! Сью! Я вхожу!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Hey, Firis. Ah, I see! You've come to get revenge on Lydie at cards!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Эй, Фирис. Ах, понятно! Пришла отомстить Лиди в карты!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Ah, that is tempting, but that's not why I'm here. I've got a gift for both of you, too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Ах, заманчиво, но я не за этим. У меня тоже есть подарок для вас обеих!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: What? You made gifts for us too?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Что? Ты и нам сделала подарки?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Of course! You've helped me a lot, too. Just this gift almost isn't enough!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Конечно! Вы тоже мне очень помогли. Одного подарка почти мало!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: I really wanted to let you know how grateful I am. So, without further delay, here you go!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Очень хотела, чтобы вы знали, как я благодарна. Итак, без проволочек — вот!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: It's got wings on it? So this is the same as your tent, Firis?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: У него есть крылья? Это то же, что твоя палатка, Фирис?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Yes. It's a winged, portable atelier! It's basically the same as my own atelier!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Да. Крылатое портативное ателье! По сути то же, что моё собственное!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Those wings are really great. It will fly to wherever you need it!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Эти крылья замечательные. Оно прилетит туда, куда вам нужно!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Wow. I've given up being amazed by how amazing you are, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Ух ты. Я уже перестала удивляться тому, какая ты удивительная, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Me too! Hahaha! Thank you so much for this gift.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Я тоже! Ха-ха-ха! Огромное спасибо за этот подарок.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: You seemed keen on doing some traveling, so I thought of something to help you out. That's all.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Вы будто горели желанием путешествовать, вот я и придумала, чем помочь. Вот и всё.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Traveling is great! It's fun, and you learn so much. I really want you both to try it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Путешествовать — здорово! Весело, и столько узнаёшь. Очень хочу, чтобы вы обе попробовали.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: You'll make a load of new discoveries if you do. Hahaha! The world is just so large, after all!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Если попробуете — сделаете кучу новых открытий. Ха-ха-ха! В конце концов, мир такой большой!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: OK! Hey, Sue, if we are going to travel, where do you want to go?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Ладно! Эй, Сью, если путешествовать — куда хочешь?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Good question. An island? Ooh, a quiet forest!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Хороший вопрос. На остров? Ох, в тихий лес!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Ah, I can't pick just one place! I want to see loads of different places!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Ах, не могу выбрать одно место! Хочу увидеть кучу разных!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Well said! Me too. So let's really push the boat out...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Хорошо сказано! Я тоже. Так что давайте размахнёмся по-крупному...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Hmmmm, seeing them have so much fun is making me itch to get back on the road, too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Хмммм, глядя, как им весело, мне тоже не терпится снова в путь!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: North, south, or maybe west! Which way should I head next?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Север, юг или, может, запад? Куда мне дальше?
